1.FoodDes: The Maulers' choice of food is as brutal they are! Maulers are not picky eaters and will often eat what they can. They do however, have a keenness for meat. This mishmash of rare meats is a Mauler favorite! The Maulers favor putting all of the meat they kill into a pot and stewing it for a few hours. Then they add a powder that thickens the broth. At first glance, the broth looks like a strange cauldron of boiling concoctions, which is known to put some diners off, but in actuality their cuisine is tastes far better than it looks, being that it's rich and flavorful to the tongue.

2.FoodDes: It's said that nobody is able to handle more than one bite of the spicy dragon hen. This strange looking bird is able turn brave warriors into whimpering babies. The bright red fowl can be found upon the Steelhorn Cliffs. But remember, there are few delicacies that are considered hotter than this bird. You have been warned!

3.FoodDes: The forest salad is an assortment of the forest's healthiest and most delicious vegetables and fruits. This dish is popular among all Wilders and is regularly served on special occasions.

4.FoodDes: Even pirates can be picky! After countless years at sea the pirates have become very particular about what they choose to eat. This delicious dish is packed full of the finest seafood that Esperia's oceans have to offer. This dish can be found within any seaside tavern and is one of the most popular coastal town dishes available.

5.FoodDes: The dragonberry is the fruit that is most associated with the feast of the beasts festival, as a way of giving thanks to friends. Not only can the dragonberry be peeled and eaten, this juicy fruit can also be used to create a deliciously sweet drink that is most certainly a feast-favorite.

6.FoodDes: Pronghorns are very agile creatures, thus extremely difficult to catch! Their meat is among the most tender in the land, however only the most adept hunters are capable of spearing one of these creatures and bringing it home. This delicacy always leaves a long-lasting impression on anyone who's lucky enough to taste it.

7.FoodDes: Served within every reputable tavern in Esperia, this nutritious pie is what every traveler needs after a long day of riding across the realm. Those that frequently travel are all too familiar with this delicious feel-good food.
